name: Overclocked Grid
text: +1 RAM each turn, but you draw 1 fewer program.

name: Scorched Net
text: Every enemy starts each fight with 4 Burn. Enemies have 15% more HP.

name: Hard Shell
text: Jack into every fight with 8 Firewall. Safehouses repair half as much.

name: Daemon Season
text: +1 daemon slot and daemons get +2 HP. Enemy attacks deal +1 damage.

name: Cold Market
text: Start with +100 creds, but fights pay half the creds.

name: Field Patch
text: Repair 4 HP after each fight you win, but your max HP is 15 lower.

name: Wide Scan
text: One more program choice after fights and one more subroutine choice. Enemies deal 10% more damage.

name: Burst Protocol
text: Every 5th program you run in a fight gives +1 RAM. Enemies have 10% more HP.

name: Glass Duel
text: Every fight starts with 2 Brittle on you and on every enemy.

name: Ghost Lines
text: +2 jumps per layer. Safehouses repair 25% less.
